userExplanation: We observed that emails to Gmail are frequently landing in the Promotions or Spam folders. This behavior correlates strongly with the 'urgent' language used in your subject line and a slightly elevated bounce rate. While technical authentication (SPF/DKIM) is perfect, the aggressive tone may be triggering filters. We recommend testing a more neutral subject line to see if inbox placement improves.
